_doc: Single source of truth for who may write where. Read by guard_boundaries.py (PreToolUse). Paths are project-relative POSIX globs (fnmatch: * also matches /). 'deny' wins over 'write'.

coder.why: The coder implements SPEC.md in src/. It must never weaken the tests that judge it, the spec that defines it, or the hooks that guard it.

tester.why: The tester writes tests from SPEC.md only. It must never 'fix' the code to make its own tests pass.

orchestrator.why: The main session plans and delegates: src/ goes to the coder agent, tests/ to the tester agent. Set SENTINEL_HUMAN_OVERRIDE=1 for a deliberate human edit.

readonly.why: Any other subagent (Explore, Plan, ...) is read-only in this project.
